start_questions.name: Errand
start_questions.text: What brings you to the archive?

options.text: I study the old river and its maps.
I was a copyist's apprentice, and I keep my own pen.

evidence.name: The stitched map
evidence.description: The river map lies under the copyist's blotter, its torn edge newly mended.
facts: The map was under the blotter, not in the vault.
Its torn edge has been mended with new thread.

interpretations.text: The copyist took the map and hid it.
Pell trusts him: he took it only to mend it.
